extracted.name: Fried Bread
extracted.description: I wanted to make something quick and easy for breakfast. I used tuna spread on this, very tasty! My daughter ate one with cheese. This recipe yields 12 fried bread. You can always make it smaller or bigger.
instruction_lines: Combine all dry ingredients and mix well.
Pour warm water bit by bit and mix with a spatula or spoon.
Knead. If the dough is too dry, add water. If it's too wet, add flour.
Cover and wait for 10 minutes. Divide into 12 parts.
Spread about 1 tablespoon of flour on your working space. Flatten the dough and roll into roundish shape.
Heat oil in a pan. I use medium heat. Fry flattened dough. It takes less than one minute for each side to brown, so flip after one side has become brown.
